notes: Partition checked: all 25 source ids and all 36 target ids appear exactly once, and every head belongs to its array.

`הַ` + `יָשָׁר` is divided as rule 41 directs: the substantival article takes *that which* and heads on *that*, while the adjective keeps *was right*, the supplied copula staying with the predicate word (rule 20).

`רַק` takes *howbeit*. The word is in rule 14's open connective list, but no waw opens this clause, so the restrictive particle is the only morpheme that licenses it; folding it elsewhere would leave an `added` against rule 30's reservation.
`כְּ` → *according to* fuses as one compound-preposition rendering under rule 30 and heads on *according* under rule 24, the connective *to* not being the lexeme-bearing word.

*did ... corruptly* is read as one light-verb rendering of the Hiphil participle, headed on the complement (rule 44), discontinuous around the *yet* that belongs to `עוֹד` (rule 25). Heading on *did* was available but rule 44 explicitly forbids preferring the English verb.
